annotations.description: Scrapes have failed for 30 minutes. Check the target error in Prometheus, NetworkPolicies, routing, TLS and endpoint health. Job={{ $labels.job }}, endpoint={{ $labels.endpoint }}, path={{ $labels.metrics_path }}.

rules.expr:
(
  group by (job, namespace, service, node, endpoint, metrics_path) (present_over_time(up[24h]))
  unless
  group by (job, namespace, service, node, endpoint, metrics_path) (up)
)
unless on (namespace, service)
(
  (
    group by (namespace, service) (present_over_time(kube_service_info[24h]))
    unless
    group by (namespace, service) (kube_service_info)
  )
  and on () (count(kube_service_info) > 0)
)
unless on (job)
(
  (
    group by (job) (label_replace(present_over_time(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_targets{scrape_job=~"podMonitor/.+"}[24h]), "job", "$1", "scrape_job", "podMonitor/(.+)/[0-9]+"))
    unless
    group by (job) (label_replace(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_targets{scrape_job=~"podMonitor/.+"}, "job", "$1", "scrape_job", "podMonitor/(.+)/[0-9]+"))
  )
  and on () (count(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_targets) > 0)
)

annotations.description: A scrape group seen in the last 24 hours has been absent for 30 minutes. Check ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor/ScrapeConfig discovery and endpoints. Groups are excluded once their removal is observed: the backing Service was deleted (kube_service_info), or the PodMonitor was deleted (its scrape pool left Prometheus). Each exclusion turns off if its source metric is missing entirely, so a broken kube-state-metrics or self-scrape fails closed. Other removals (ScrapeConfigs, Probes, Services still present) expire after the 24-hour history window. Pod/instance labels are ignored to tolerate replacements. Stable node labels are retained where the scraper supplies them.
No healthy target for required job kubelet for 30 minutes, including when discovery returns no targets. Check discovery, NetworkPolicies and node endpoints.
No healthy target for required job node-exporter for 30 minutes, including when discovery returns no targets. Check discovery, NetworkPolicies and node endpoints.
No healthy target for required job etcd for 30 minutes, including when discovery returns no targets. Check discovery, NetworkPolicies and node endpoints.
